name: readxl
resume: readxl 1.5.0.1 is in progress. cellranger is not in the registry, so cell_limits, cell_rows, cell_cols, and anchored live here. tibble is loaded for new_tibble. cpp11 and progress are the compile bridge and the spinner and are not translated. The xls and xlsx readers are still reserved.

functions.name: anchored
functions.done: The upper left is the anchor and the extent is dim rows by dim columns.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(readxl))
one <- function() {
  paste(capture.output(print(anchored("C4", dim = c(3, 2)))), collapse = "\n")
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat("VALUE\n")
cat(value, "\n", sep = "")
cat("<<<END>>>\n")
cat(sprintf("MS %.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import sys
import time

from readxl import anchored
def one():
    return str(anchored("C4", dim=(3, 2)))

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
sys.stdout.write("VALUE\n")
sys.stdout.write(value)
sys.stdout.write("\n<<<END>>>\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}\n")

import statistics
import sys
import time

from readxl import excel_format, readxl_example
def one():
    files = ["a.xlsx", "b.xls", "c.png", "/etc/hostname", readxl_example("clippy.xlsx"), readxl_example("deaths.xls")]
    return "|".join("NA" if item is None else item for item in excel_format(files))

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
sys.stdout.write("VALUE\n")
sys.stdout.write(value)
sys.stdout.write("\n<<<END>>>\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"MS {statistics.median(elapsed):.17g}\n")
